name: Question 4
problem:
The acceleration $a$ at time $t$ of a particle $P$ moving in the $xy$-plane is given by

$$
a(t)=⟨{e}^{2t},{e}^{3t}⟩.
$$

Given that the particle has velocity $v=⟨{e}^{2},{e}^{3}⟩$ when $t=1,$ calculate the velocity vector of $P$ at time $t.$

The acceleration a at time t of a particle P moving in the xy-plane is given by a(t)=⟨e2t,e3t⟩. Given that the particle has velocity v=⟨e2,e3⟩ when t=1, calculate the velocity vector of P at time t.

a
v=⟨12e2t−32e2,13e3t+23e3⟩
b
v=⟨32e2t+32e2,13e3t+23e3⟩
c
v=⟨12e2t−12e2,13e3t−23e3⟩
d
v=⟨12e2t+12e2,13e3t+23e3⟩
e
v=⟨12e2t+32e2,23e3t+23e3⟩
